correctness.rationale: Every nine-point subset of F_2^5 has affine rank four or five. Rank five corresponds bijectively to a dimension-three even length-nine relation code with minimum weight at least four. A generator-column multiset normal form gives 11,440 weak compositions, 148 feasible instances and six GL_3(2) orbits. Rank-four supports lie in exactly one of 62 hyperplanes, and the exhaustive AGL_4(2) subset-orbit enumeration gives three classes. Independent direct Walsh sums and relation-dual code spectra agree for every rank-five representative. Exact stabilizer indices and hyperplane multiplicities sum to binomial(32,9)=28,048,800. Explicit pair is inequivalent by its GL_3-invariant column-multiplicity pattern. The standalone checker was run successfully on the final code.

value.rationale: The multiset of absolute Walsh magnitudes is a natural affine-invariant phaseless statistic of sparse Boolean supports. The complete nine-point five-cube classification establishes exactly one double fiber, gives an explicit inequivalent pair, and determines all nine orbit multiplicities and the prevalence 1792/5655. This sharply locates the limitation of unlabelled Fourier-magnitude recognition for a canonical smallest nontrivial binary sparse configuration beyond the eight-point census. The invariant, not mere feasibility or code recomputation, is the motivating object.
